screen.title: New post
screen.subtitle: Upload the video once and it goes out to every platform you turn on.

text.hashtagsHint: Press Enter to add. Separate several with commas.

timing.pastTime: That moment has already passed, so the post goes out right away.
timing.nativePlan: {{platform}} schedules it on its side. You can close the tab.
timing.serverPlan: AnycastStudio publishes it at that moment. You can close the tab.
timing.deferredPlan: AnycastStudio starts the upload to {{platform}} at that moment; the post appears a few minutes later. You can close the tab.
timing.immediate: Goes out as soon as you publish.

video.formats: MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI or MKV.
video.resumeHint: {{done}} of {{total}} MB already reached the server. Choose the same file to carry on.
video.resumeMismatch: That is a different file. Choose the one the upload started with.

error.payload_too_large: That file is larger than your per-file limit.
error.quota_exceeded: Not enough storage left. Delete something first.
error.conflict: Too many uploads at once. Wait for one to finish.
error.invalid: The upload did not arrive intact. Try again.
error.unauthorized: Your session expired. Sign in again.

summary.needsPlatform: Turn on at least one platform.
summary.needsUpload: Wait for the upload to finish.
summary.needsAccount: Connect a {{platform}} account or turn {{platform}} off.

error.dailyLimit: You have reached today's publication limit.
error.unknown: Could not start publishing. Try again.

invalid.fileTooLarge: The video is too large for {{platform}}.
invalid.unsupportedType: {{platform}} does not accept this video format.
invalid.captionTooLong: Title, description and hashtags together are too long for {{platform}}.
invalid.privacyRequired: Choose who can watch the video in {{platform}} settings.
invalid.commercialContentUnspecified: Say whose brand the {{platform}} post promotes.
invalid.brandedContentCannotBePrivate: Branded content on {{platform}} cannot be private.
invalid.tooManyHashtags: {{platform}} allows at most 30 hashtags in the caption.
invalid.videoTooShort: The video is too short for {{platform}}.
invalid.videoTooLong: The video is too long for {{platform}}.

drawer.subtitle: settings for this post
drawer.previewLead: This is how the post will look on {{platform}}.

note.youtube: Horizontal 16:9. The feed shows the cover and the title.
note.tiktok: TikTok shows no title: the title, description and hashtags go into the caption.
note.instagram: Reels: the title, description and hashtags go into the caption.
note.x: The post text is the title, description and hashtags, up to 280 characters.
